Package com.example.cosmos_discovery.messaging

Class CosmosFcmService

android.app.Service
com.google.firebase.messaging.EnhancedIntentService
com.google.firebase.messaging.FirebaseMessagingService
com.example.cosmos_discovery.messaging.CosmosFcmService
public class CosmosFcmService extends com.google.firebase.messaging.FirebaseMessagingService
Receives FCM messages and surfaces them as Android system notifications. Token refreshes are written back to the signed-in user's Firestore doc. Background-delivered messages with a notification payload are auto-displayed by the FCM SDK using the manifest meta-data; this class handles foreground delivery and data-only payloads explicitly.
